facts.fact: 六个月后 Romaine 找到被销毁的监控录像。
facts.anchor: Six months later, I’ve finally tracked down the destroyed camera footage.

facts.fact: 那些人的死不在他计划内，但结果更好。
facts.anchor: While everyone’s deaths were admittedly…not in my plans…it was working out better than expected.

facts.fact: 他的手抓向衣服下的疤。
facts.anchor: My hand jerks to my shoulder. To the scar that hides beneath my clothes.

facts.fact: 画面里是他以为杀掉的女人的幽灵。
facts.anchor: it wasn’t the ghost of someone I thought I killed.

facts.fact: 那个女人当年让他中了一枪。
facts.anchor: The one who managed to get me shot in the process.

facts.fact: 如果她还活着他必须找到她。
facts.anchor: If she is alive, I must find her.

facts.fact: 不能让 Roux 家先找到她。
facts.anchor: I cannot allow the Rouxs to locate her first.
